# AHM Benchmark repository guidance

Follow `AGENTS.md` and the v0.5.0 specification.

Raw observations remain immutable. Derived measurements remain versioned. Registry IDs, relation values, opportunity classes, evidence spans, factual-packet gates, formulas, thresholds, and A/B/C estimands are scientific semantics.

Keep ontology instantiation separate for historical-materialist, neoclassical, and institutionalist groups. Keep accuracy separate from all three. Monitor-only features never enter primary denominators. Closed-provider contrasts support descriptive claims. Controlled causal arms support causal claims.

Keep pandas and DuckDB outputs equivalent. Add offline tests with scorer or schema changes. Preserve runner concurrency limits, resume/retry behavior, append-safe JSONL, and deterministic request identities. Model-generated results never become configuration.
